label: Card & Card Grid
description: A styled Card (optional media area on top, title, body text, footer/actions strip, Clicked signal, hover affordance) plus a responsive Card Grid that repeats it over any data array. The grid packs as many 240px-minimum columns as fit and degrades to a single full-width column when narrow. Out of the box it renders six sample cards from a Static Data node; connect your own array (Title/Body/Image/Footer per item) to the Items input and it wins over the samples. The grid forwards each card's click as Card Clicked with Clicked Title and Clicked Item Id.
